_comment: ruby#421 -- the engine-compat manifest. Every release train updates the pairings as it rides; tools/check_engine_compat.py verifies the manifest against the live registries in CI (tag <-> engine_commit, crates, npm, rubygems, pypi). Runtime versions follow the engine-linked scheme {engine-semver}.{runtime-single-digit} (npm: the engine semver, the 4th segment is invalid there) -- the leptris precedent. The rubygems/npm entries follow the current train's actual spellings (1.5.15, 3-segment). The 1.5.18 train carries the string-scan shape (rs#574 option A, rs#666): the whole-string wire change; the armv7-musl PyPI wheel sits this train out (the pypa image bump's rust std, noted on parsanol-python#72).
